occurrences.subsection_title: Here Begins the Section on Practice
occurrences.snippet: One should purify the path of the breath by pūraka, kumbhaka and recaka (inhalation, retention and exhalation); the tongue by pronouncing ṭa and ka; and the fingers by exercise.
